QUOTE: "#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member" and "Inside them the macro expands to the plain name, so `ssl->state` compiles." and "By default that field is named `private_state`. Application code that writes `ssl->state` fails to compile"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both branches and says opt-out code (library, ssl_server2) sees plain names while ordinary external consumers see the `private_`-prefixed names.
